faq.q: Can I take the train to a Mission open house on the weekend?
faq.a: Not on the regular schedule: the West Coast Express is a weekday commuter service between Mission City Station and Waterfront Station (69 km, approximately 75 minutes), westbound in the morning and eastbound in the afternoon, with no regular weekend or statutory-holiday service — Mission City Station is the line's eastern terminus.

faq.q: A Mission open house home has a suite — what should I check?
faq.a: Its registration status. Mission requires all secondary suites to be registered with the City; a suite is a self-contained living space in a single family home forming part of the same real estate entity, suites are not permitted in townhouses or rowhomes, and a new suite goes through the building permit process — an unregistered suite can be investigated and may require a decommission permit.
